"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"If Russia can realize the enormous potential of its people and abundant resources, it can achieve the greatness that is currently defined solely by the reach of its weapons.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"With Russia, the United States needs patience, consistency, and a principled reliance on democratic forces.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
